about: A randomized test of a new checkout. One row per user; 'variant' says which checkout they saw.
review: Goals and labels drafted by Claude on 2026-11-14, paraphrases written by Claude. Labels reviewed by Ben on 2026-11-17.

goals.goal: Did the new checkout raise purchases?
paraphrases: Are more people buying with the new checkout?
Did the checkout redesign move conversion?
new checkout = more orders?
did the new chekout get more ppl to purchse

labels.why: Purchase rate, new checkout against the old one.
Revenue goes up with purchases, but it isn't the count of buyers.

goals.goal: Did the new checkout bring in more money per user?
paraphrases: Is revenue per visitor higher with the new checkout?
Did ARPU improve in the test arm?
more $ from each customer on the new flow?
does the new chekout make more revenu per person

labels.why: Average revenue per user by checkout.
More buyers usually means more money, but it doesn't measure money.

goals.goal: Was the checkout redesign worth it?
paraphrases: Should we keep the new checkout?
Did the redesign pay off?
is the new checkout a win or not
Was the checkout project a good investment?

labels.why: 'Worth it' is usually money.
Or whether more people bought. Both fit a vague goal equally well.
Engagement is a weak reading of 'worth it'.

goals.goal: Do people come back more often with the new checkout?
paraphrases: Did the new checkout increase sessions per user?
Are users visiting more since they got the new checkout?
more repeat visits on the new flow?
does the new chekout get people to return

labels.why: Sessions per user is the only measure of coming back.

goals.goal: We split traffic at random between the two checkouts. Did conversion go up?
paraphrases: It was a proper A/B test. Did the treatment convert better?
Users were randomly assigned. Is the new checkout's conversion rate higher?
randomized test, did conversions improve
In our 50/50 test, did more people check out on the new version?

labels.why: Conversion is the purchase rate.
Related, but not conversion.

goals.goal: Did average spend go up for people on the new version?
paraphrases: Are new-checkout users spending more on average?
Did basket value per user rise?
spend per user, new vs old checkout
do people spend more mony with the new one

labels.why: Revenue per user is spend per user.

goals.goal: Do German customers buy less than US customers?
paraphrases: Is the purchase rate lower in Germany than in the US?
DE vs US conversion
Are Germans less likely to buy than Americans?
do german shoppers purchase less often then US ones

labels.why: In an experiment, compare countries within each checkout: does the new checkout's effect on buying differ by country? (Ben, 2026-11-17.) The app can't suggest this yet.
Purchase rate by country, ignoring which checkout people saw.

goals.goal: Is revenue different on mobile and desktop?
paraphrases: Do desktop users bring in more money than mobile users?
revenue by device
Mobile vs desktop: who spends more?
does mobile make less revenue then desktop

labels.why: Does the new checkout's effect on revenue differ between mobile and desktop? (Ben, 2026-11-17.) The app can't suggest this yet.
Revenue by device, ignoring which checkout people saw.

goals.goal: Did the old checkout actually make more money?
paraphrases: Was control better than the new checkout on revenue?
Did we lose revenue by switching?
is the old flow still earning more
Did the new checkout hurt sales?

labels.why: Revenue by checkout; the direction doesn't change which question answers it.
Sales could mean the number of buyers.

goals.goal: Are mobile users less likely to buy?
paraphrases: Does mobile convert worse than desktop?
purchase rate on phones vs computers
Is buying lower on mobile?
do ppl on mobile purchase less

labels.why: Does the new checkout's effect on buying differ between mobile and desktop? (Ben, 2026-11-17.) The app can't suggest this yet.
Purchase rate by device, ignoring which checkout people saw.

goals.goal: Did purchases go up after we launched the new checkout last month?
paraphrases: Since the new checkout went live, are we selling more?
Did sales rise after the launch date?
purchases before vs after the release
have orders gone up since we rolled out the new checkout

labels.why: No dates, but comparing the two checkouts answers whether the new one sells more.

goals.goal: Did the new checkout reduce refunds?
paraphrases: Are fewer orders being returned with the new checkout?
Did the refund rate drop?
less returns on the new flow?
did chargebacks go down with the new checkout

goals.goal: Are customers happier with the new checkout?
paraphrases: Did customer satisfaction improve with the new checkout?
Did CSAT go up in the test arm?
do people like the new checkout more
Is the new checkout getting better ratings?
